hypothesis: Four exact-state action-resampling branches per d3/d5 parent state increase failure diversity while preserving FACT's no-failure-imitation and observed-future/value contracts.
parent_source: C48 train-split successful parent episodes only

split.contract: Hash and split by source_id plus successful C48 parent episode; both d3/d5 and all four candidates remain together.

selection.contract: Audit every frozen job but retain only terminal failed branches in the training dataset.

onset.contract: The frozen exact sim-state branch start is the explicit causal action-intervention onset; no visual irreversible-failure onset is inferred.

action.contract: Observed failed-branch actions remain clean causal inputs, but action_loss_mask is exactly 0 for every retained row.

future_and_value.contract: Future observation/state comes from an exact later row or terminal observation of the actual failed branch; terminal time/outcome supplies FACT code remaining+1 and paper progress-1 separately.

branch_identity.contract: Result launch fields, parent path/index/step, seeds, first JSON action chunk and saved NPZ first action chunk must all match the frozen job exactly.

compatibility.rationale: C61 reuses the already-audited C60 FACT loader semantics without changing model code; provenance and identities remain explicit C61 fields.

decision.rationale: Formal finalization requires 1128/1128 exact result coverage plus every node COMPLETED marker. Before that, only explicit --audit-inventory is allowed and it is read-only: it never creates dataset.pt or COMPLETED.json.
